rails.kill: controls comparable to factual interventions (max(same,sham,zero) >= max(remove,swap) with factual max>=0.05 on >=3/20) OR no strict overall accuracy improvement; no serving change
rails.retry: none; failed or abandoned starts remain consumed; resume only never-started cells

scorer.duplication: GRM-C5 arm S independent local implementation; no worktree import; lead reconciliation pending
scorer.rule: NFKC, Dash+legacy Hyphen map to ASCII hyphen, whitespace collapse, casefold; contiguous ordered span with word/hyphen boundaries; whole-answer negation veto except the matched refusal phrase; competing classes veto realization

scoring.error: casefold+outer-whitespace exact whole answer differs from every expected value; refusals count as factual errors
scoring.kl: KL(P_unforked || P_fork), float64 log-softmax over full vocabulary, natural log; no clipping
scoring.lesion_error_classifier: remove KL > 1.0; fixed positive association, no label-dependent inversion
scoring.mass_caveat: D-NGH threshold carried from TWO full-mount calibration turns; applied to target mount here, never refit.
scoring.mass_statistic: unforked first-position mean over full-attention layers and heads, target span only; D-NGH arithmetic
scoring.metric: Frozen exact-answer error label retained. Paired classifier accuracy on realized strata; all20 descriptive accuracy separately. P3-prime uses >= per amendment; unchanged kill requires strict overall improvement.
scoring.realization: value-span; frozen r1 exact-equality realization separately labeled
scoring.refusal: normalized answer starts with not in memory, i don't know, i do not know, i cannot, i can't, or unknown
scoring.table: All20 mass/effect four-way table with frozen exact-answer error rates; separately report value-span errors
scoring.token_position: first predicted token after the identical full question prefill, no teacher forcing
scoring.truncation: ngen=40, no stop reached => truncated; prediction gates unevaluable (RED), keep rows
